release.content: pubsec 0.2.3 was released on 2026-11-16 from commit 79dd6d93fee447aba313ddfa4cf9d02b3d316988 with these changes.

rows: gcp.service-account-key: a key an organization policy forbids (iam.disableServiceAccountKeyCreation) is blocked, naming the policy and the ways out, not missing with gcloud's last line

gcp.workload-identity (propose): a workload's Kubernetes ServiceAccount may act as a Google service account through a Workload Identity pool, read from the account's IAM policy; missing proposes the workloadIdentityUser grant and, with granted_in, the row that makes it

release.scope: the published release v0.2.3 of pubsec
